    OLBG Prizes' £6,000 Football Instants Draw: 1,242 Instant Wins Plus a £500 Cash End Prize

    Updated: Oct 16, 12:25 26 OLBG Prizes
    1,242 football instant wins worth over £5,000, plus a £500 cash end prize drawn 29 October. Top instant: £1,000 matchday hospitality at the club of your choice.
    Listen to audio version of this article

    Jake Ashton - Your Betting Odds Guide 👍

    I break betting odds news as it happens, so you’re never left behind when the market moves or a top offer lands.

    • 1,242 pre-allocated football instant win prizes across the ticket pool
    • Top instant win: matchday hospitality for two at the club of your choice (worth up to £1,000)
    • Eight signed football shirts from England and club legends in the mix

    Two Ways to Win From Every Ticket

    Following the format of the Racing Instants draw earlier this month, OLBG Prizes has launched its football twin, a £6,000 Football Instants Giveaway carrying 1,242 pre-allocated instant win prizes alongside a £500 cash end prize.

    Every ticket in the pool is entered into both parts of the giveaway. Buy a ticket allocated to one of the 1,242 winning numbers and the instant prize lands the moment the purchase is confirmed. 

    Buy any ticket at all and it's automatically entered into the £500 cash end prize draw taking place on Thursday 29 October at 7:30pm, a draw where a winner is picked regardless of how many tickets have sold.

    Tickets are 99p each, with the instant win pool valued at over £5,000 and the top instant prize alone, matchday hospitality for two at the club of your choice, worth up to £1,000.

    Check out the Competition on OLBG Prizes NOW

    Get Tickets For The Football Instants Giveaway HERE

    The £500 End Prize

    The £500 cash end prize is settled by an automatic draw at 7:30pm on Thursday 29 October, or shortly after if the ticket cap fills earlier. 

    A winner is drawn from every ticket in the pool at close, and the prize pays out whether the draw fills light or runs to the full cap.

    That's the guaranteed part of the giveaway. The 1,242 instant wins are the layer sitting on top.

    The 1,242 Instant Win Prize Pool

    The instant wins are pre-allocated to specific ticket numbers. When a ticket carrying a winning number is bought, the entrant is notified immediately.

    How to Enter

    Tickets can be bought via the OLBG Prizes site at 99p each. A free postal entry route is also available under the standard site terms and conditions, provided the entrant is registered online first.

    Each ticket carries an automatically-allocated number at the point of purchase. 

    If that number matches one of the 1,242 pre-allocated instant win prizes, the winner is notified immediately. Every ticket is also entered into the £500 cash end prize draw.
